protocol: Six clustered C procbench rounds; one common parent per round, grouped command runs, all six role permutations. External procbench counters include kernel and user; positive with no multiplexing marker. Backend inner counters exclude kernel/hypervisor, retain no enabled/running times, and are not covered by that external-counter qualification. Wall release-to-wait4 differs from time-runs. Even medians are the midpoint of the two central values. Per-round main reference is the midpoint of A1 and A2 medians.
